answer: One account, one passkey. At sign-up the wallet runs a WebAuthn ceremony and stores the attestation as a vertex in the network's identity graph: one key per account, never two identities per key. Step 1: enroll with biometrics or a $25 security key. Step 2: reused keys rejected. Step 3: challenges use the same key. An attacker needs one device per identity: $25 to $50 each plus 10 minutes of manual enrollment. 200 fakes cost $5,000 and 33 hours of manual work. That turns back the tide of cheap Sybil accounts and stops a spiral of endless sockpuppets.
